title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Bulevardi Zhan D'ark, Brryli, Tiranë
description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje apartament i tipologjise 3+1 me siperfaqe 98 m2 ne katin e 1 ne objekt te vitit 2000 pa ashensor.
Apartamenti eshte i mobiluar. Ndodhet prane Ministrise se Jashtme dhe me akses te menjehershem tek Bulevardi "Zhan Dark". Ne cmim perfshihet dhe nje post parkimi me siperfaqe 8 m2.
Apartamenti ka mundesi ndarje perfekte ne 2 apartamente.
Apartamenti eshte i pershtatshem edhe per aktivitete biznesi si, klinike dentare, zyre kontabilieteti, per shkak te afersise me qendren dhe rruget kryesore.
Me dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Zhan D'ark Boulevard, Brryli, Tirana
description_en: Offered for sale is a 3+1 typology apartment with a surface area of ​​98 m2 on the 1st floor in a building built in 2000 without an elevator. The apartment is furnished. It is located near the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and with immediate access to "Zhan Dark" Boulevard. The price includes a parking post with an area of ​​8 m2. The apartment has the possibility of perfect division into 2 apartments. The apartment is also suitable for business activities such as dental clinic, accounting office, due to its proximity to the center and main roads. With regular mortgage documentation.
